why_required: Native evidence must state exact runtime baseline
artifact_or_note: Record FreeCADCmd path, FreeCAD revision, OCCT version and LibPack or build baseline; without this S2 cannot distinguish native behavior from environment drift.

why_required: Enabled Mutated PartialLoad must be separated
artifact_or_note: Probe matrix must include Disabled control, Enabled pre-mutation setup, Mutated copied-object path and PartialLoad True boundary as separate rows with support count and diagnostic state.
Record support.size, target object and rejection for zero or multi-support because setupCopyOnChange returns before dynamic CopyOnChange property wiring unless exactly one support exists.

why_required: FreeCAD uses temporary binder during copied-object update
artifact_or_note: Must show whether _tmp_binder is created during Mutated update and whether evidence can be exported as artifact without relying on a persistent backend session or temporary document handle.

why_required: _CopiedObjs must expose stable copied object identities
artifact_or_note: Must include copied object names, typeIds, ids if available, source object relation, _CopiedObjs count and stored order after reverse insertion from copyObject returnAll.

why_required: copyObject dependency order is core graph evidence
artifact_or_note: Must record recursive copyObject dependency list, dependency edges, imported object order and root copy position so frontend can persist a deterministic copied graph.

why_required: Copied support must rewrite links to copied objects
artifact_or_note: Must record Support before mutation, _CopiedLink target and subvalues after copy, and any copied support rewrite map from source objects to copied objects.
Must record initial recomputeFeature true after copyObject, second recompute after CopyOnChange property paste, validity, recompute logs and diagnostic text for both failure modes.

why_required: ElementMap/NamedShape lifecycle cannot become backend cache
artifact_or_note: Must capture ElementMap or NamedShape lifecycle before and after recompute, then judge whether evidence is serializable into request graph updates rather than post-request cache state.

why_required: Cache_* must be classified as required semantic state or optimization
artifact_or_note: Probe note must classify Cache_* dynamic matrix entries as transform rebuild optimization unless native evidence proves they are required copied graph semantic state; backend persistent cache remains forbidden.
